WITH store_sales_cte AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk, ss_sold_date_sk 
    FROM store_sales 
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
),
web_sales_cte AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_sold_date_sk 
    FROM web_sales 
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
),
catalog_sales_cte AS (
    SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk, cs_sold_date_sk 
    FROM catalog_sales 
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
)
SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, COUNT(*) cnt, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating 
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk AND ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
LEFT JOIN store_sales_cte ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk 
LEFT JOIN web_sales_cte ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk 
LEFT JOIN catalog_sales_cte cs ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_ship_customer_sk 
WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk IS NULL AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk IS NULL AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk IS NULL
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
